Enforcement floors live in `vitest.config.ts`. The src files that config `exclude`s

**These numbers come from the default vitest project only.** `tests/vapor/**` runs
under `vitest.vapor.config.ts` (it needs `vue` aliased to the with-vapor build) and is
not included here. Two modules run only there: `src/router/vapor.ts` and

above, and this table holds no figure for them.

For the rest, a diff of both projects' per-statement and per-branch hit maps on

(recorded 2026-08-18 in v1.15, before either Vapor module existed). Re-run that diff
before trusting these numbers to describe code a Vapor fixture reaches.

What those fixtures add is not lines but *environment*: proof the code behaves
correctly inside a real Vapor component, which line coverage cannot express either way.
